about: Cameras in Prince's room (prince/space.py). One entry per photo.

anchor_front.status: the depth model's camera (MoGe-2), owner 2026-11-17: 'I agree with whatever the model says'; his size: 15.5 cm wide (approved), the rest measured

inputs.source: the depth model Ruicheng/moge-2-vitl-normal (data/scene/visible_depth_moge2.json, tools/visible_depth.py); OWNER 2026-11-17: 'I agree with whatever the model says'
inputs.lens: 1795.4 px: the model's own estimate; its rays take the picture's centre as straight ahead
inputs.distance: camera to his nose 24.5 cm (the model). The owner first remembered about six inches: 'Maybe I misremembered. Either way I trust them'
inputs.height: OWNER: 'basically exactly at his eye level. Maybe just a tiny bit lower' -> his eyes 0.5 cm above the camera; this sets which way is up (the cropped picture's centre does not: lessons 26, 29)
inputs.turn: straight on: not turned, not rolled
inputs.size: his width, 15.5 cm (OWNER-approved), sets the size; the model cannot tell size from this background-free photo. Everything else is the model's
inputs.surface: he sat on a soft surface; y = 0 goes through the middle of his two peet bottoms (measured)
inputs.origin: the surface under the middle of his two peet bottoms (measured, 4 px inside his outline)

his_size_estimate_cm.how: measured by the depth model (its proportions), 15.5 cm wide (approved); top of head and ear tips read 4 px inside his outline; OWNER 2026-11-17: 'I agree with whatever the model says'

anchor_front.picture_centre: 7.2 deg down: the cropped picture's centre is not where the camera aimed (lesson 26)

anchor_front_six_inches_superseded.status: SUPERSEDED 2026-11-17 by the depth model's camera (anchor_front). Placed as the owner first remembered the shot (2026-11-16, six inches); it assumed his peets right under his face. Kept as a record only

inputs.distance: OWNER: camera to his nose 15.24 cm ('he was roughly 6 inches away from the camera'; 'it couldn't have been more than six inches away'; range 12-15.24)
inputs.height: OWNER: 'basically exactly at his eye level. Maybe just a tiny bit lower' -> his eyes 2.45 cm above the camera -- the smallest drop below his eyes at which he reaches the owner's size floor (top of his head >= 12.7 cm)
inputs.tilt: OWNER: straight on, 'maybe looking ever so slightly up' -> tilted up 1.0 deg (range 0-2), not turned
inputs.aim: from the owner's memory: the camera aimed at his face, so its aim point in this (cropped) picture is x 548.0 (his nose), y 610.6 (the height that puts his eyes a touch above the camera); NOT the picture's centre (lesson 26)
inputs.lens: 1235.5 px: the SHORTEST lens that fits (26.0 mm-equivalent phone main camera, this picture cropped from a 3:4 frame centred on the aim point, the smallest frame that holds it); a longer lens would make him smaller still, below the owner's size floor
inputs.surface: he sat on a soft surface (his peets may sink in a little); y = 0 is that surface
inputs.peets_under_face: ASSUMED: the front of his peets is right under the front of his face

anchor_front_six_inches_superseded.check: a measurement of him (width across his widest point, or height to the top of his head) would confirm the lens and his size

his_size_estimate_cm.how: rough: body taken as round; top of head and ears 3.0 cm behind his nose; check: is this the size of a little fluffy rabbit? (owner)

anchor_front_six_inches_superseded.note_width: his widest outline at his nose's distance; his sides are further back, so he is wider
